title: Face shape and features (analyze_face) arguments
description: Run YouCam AI Face Attribute analysis on the client's photo: face shape and eye, eyelid, brow, lip, nose and cheekbone shapes. Results appear on the client's Face screen. Costs 10 units for up to 5 features and 20 for 6-14.

features.description: Features to read. Omit for face, eye, lip and brow shape plus cheekbones. Colors come from analyze_skin_tone.

photo_id.description: A specific shared photo. Omit to use the latest photo.
